title: Field blocks for Bulgaria
description:
The agricultural part of the Bulgarian physical block register (физически блокове): a physical block is a
contiguous area of land bounded by permanent features, identified as <EKATTE settlement code>-<block number>
and classified by its use. The register has been produced from field checks and orthophoto mapping.

These layers hold the blocks used agriculturally — arable land, greenhouses, rice fields and courtyards —
where the Physical_Blocks layers of the same service also carry forest, urban and transport land.

This collection holds 5 editions (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025), one GeoParquet file per year under `year=<year>/` (hive layout). Read them all at once with the partition glob `s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/bg/year=*/*.parquet` (S3 through the Source Cooperative proxy, endpoint `https://data.source.coop`; plain https cannot expand `*`); the `data` asset is a copy of the latest edition (2025). Geometries are kept in the source CRS (EPSG:32635). Converted with [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli) into the [fiboa](https://github.com/fiboa/specification) schema; tested queries are in the collection's [AGENTS.md](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/bg/AGENTS.md).

Boundaries are declared: they come from farmers' subsidy applications, or from the parcel register built on those declarations.

table:columns.name: crop:name
table:columns.description: Crop name in the original language. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/crop-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: metrics:area
table:columns.description: Area of the field, in square meters (m²). Must be > 0 and <= 1,000,000,000. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: crop:code
table:columns.description: The crop code, from the code list of the source. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/crop-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: A geometry that reflects the footprint of the field, usually a Polygon. Stored in the source CRS (see `proj:code`), not reprojected. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: block_id
table:columns.description: Field identifier (source column `PHBIDENT`, per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: The bounding box of the field. Per-feature covering column (GeoParquet 1.1), in the source CRS. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

partition:keys.name: year
partition:keys.description: Edition year of the source dataset (the converter variant). Not a column in the files; DuckDB adds it with hive_partitioning=true. Expand the glob through S3 (endpoint data.source.coop, path style); plain https has no listing.

data.title: Bulgaria — latest edition (2025) (GeoParquet)
data.description: Byte-identical copy of `year=2025/bg-2025.parquet`, kept at a stable path so `*/latest/*.parquet` selects the newest edition of every collection.

style-field-size.title: Field size (ha)
style-field-size.description: Fields shaded light to dark by area in hectares (metrics:area / 10 000). Stops at 0.5, 2, 5, 20 ha, the nice values nearest this dataset's 20th/40th/60th/80th percentiles so each class holds a similar share of fields.

style-outline.title: Field boundaries
style-outline.description: Every field in one colour with a thin outline; for reading the boundaries themselves.
